authorizationBasis: Author instruction (2026-11-02) to execute the corrected-campaign plan end to end on the author's own fork and fleet. This amendment creates a new prospective allowance for the corrected study only. It is not a historical-budget reset, creates no retroactive authorization, and leaves the v1 calibration journal, retained corpus, and audit-paper seal untouched.
collectionGate: Collection remains disabled until ALL hold: (a) this amendment committed; (b) protocols/ala-lv-study.v2.json and protocols/ala-lv-analysis.v2.json frozen and committed; (c) P4 qualification passed on the exact execution source; (d) P5 admission reservation fits inside the additional allowance below. Engineering, protocol, and qualification work proceed before collection.
exploratoryPurpose: ALA-LV corrected study: same exploratory estimation question under a repaired construction (cross-case donor batches, complete coverage, per-case seeds, digest payloads, full three-partition workload). Estimation-only; no LV01 family support/power labels.
historicalPreservation: All v1 artifacts are preserved unchanged: the calibration journal and retained corpus on AVPS, the audit paper and its sealed supplement, and every LV01/LV02/LG01/E02/E03 protocol, receipt, and attempt record. Corrected-study evidence lives in separate evidence roots and never overwrites v1 paths.
journalSeeding: The retained v1 journal stays on AVPS untouched. Each v2 evidence root starts a fresh journal under this prospective allowance; v1 spend remains journalled in the retained root, so no spend is hidden by the fresh start.

newAllowance.campaignCpuHoursNote: Open until gate G2, which fills it with the measured reservation R = n*f*C + A + D. No cohort slot may be attempted while it is null.
newAllowance.label: ADDITIONAL ALLOWANCE for the corrected study (not historical headroom, not a reset)
newAllowance.perDyadCpuHoursNote: Prospective starting value: the partial v1 dyad measured 0.540 CPU-hours for 240 test slots; the complete dyad executes 720 slots plus digest payloads, so 3x the partial rate plus headroom. B2 measures the truth; exceeding this cap aborts the dyad (watchdog), it does not move the cap.
newAllowance.perDyadRetainedGiBNote: Prospective starting value: the partial v1 dyad retained 4.31 GiB with a 1.57 GiB repeated head; the v2 payload removes the repetition while tripling executed slots. Confirmed against A4 fixture measurements at G1; exceeding aborts the dyad.
newAllowance.perDyadWallMinutesNote: Prospective starting value: the partial v1 dyad took 33.7 minutes wall for 240 slots; tripled slots plus headroom. Exceeding aborts the dyad.

newCaps.analysisReproductionNote: Set at G2 from the B4 measured per-dyad analysis cost times the chosen tuple size; null until then.
newCaps.concurrencyRule: Per-host concurrency is min(floor(RAM headroom / B2 peak RSS), core cap). Shared hosts (TVPS) cap at half their cores; dedicated hosts cap at all cores. The v1 one-dyad topology is explicitly amended by this rule.
newCaps.concurrentDyadsNote: Absolute ceiling across the whole fleet; the per-host rule above binds first.
newCaps.developmentRepairNote: Distinct v2 development slot IDs (resumes free). Qualification needs at most two; the third is contingency, not an expectation. Every attempt's measured cost accrues to D.
newCaps.retainedWorkingBytesNote: 64 GiB additional working/retained for the archive host; G2 verifies the consolidated archive plus tarball/copy transients fits with 20 percent headroom. If a ceiling cannot accommodate originals, stop rather than deleting evidence.
newCaps.workerResidentNote: Carried from v1 pending B2 measurement; a B2 exceedance is diagnosed as a guard finding (as in v1), not a silent cap move.

reservationRules.A: Per-dyad analysis cost measured in B4 times the chosen tuple size, set at G2.
reservationRules.D: Summed measured cost of all v2 development attempts (slots, smokes excluded: the C0 smoke harness is a non-study determinism check, logged not journalled).
reservationRules.fNote: Twice-maximum provisioning, as in v1: provisioning policy, not a calibrated bound.

retention.lifecycle: Corrected-study evidence is retained until the G3 write-up is submitted; deletion afterwards only by a recorded author decision.
retention.manifest: Audit eligibility per dyad is defined by the v2 retained-file manifest (A7): validated batch, per-slot schedule records, heads sidecar, branch bundles, receipt, journal export.

watchdog.action: Terminate the dyad process and journal aborted with measured cost to date, charged to D.
watchdog.guards: Per-dyad CPU-hours, wall minutes, and retained GiB from newAllowance above. No dyad may complete past a guard; the audited campaign's guard-exceeding completion must not recur.
